generatedBy: workflow reconciliation + hardening pass executed by build

scope.purpose: Agent, skill, and MCP wiring for this repo: workflow configuration only.

stack.frontend: Blade + AdminLTE 4.1 + Bootstrap 5.3 + Tailwind CSS 4 + Sass + Vite 8

agents.name: build
agents.description: Default coding orchestrator — runs workflow commands, delegates to explore/general, verifies results.

agents.name: plan
agents.description: Read-only planner for complex work (>3 files, migrations, auth/billing/permission changes).

agents.name: explore
agents.description: Fast read-only code search — locates files and symbols and maps flows.

agents.name: general
agents.description: General-purpose subagent for multi-step work units and parallel slices.

agents.name: verify
agents.description: Adversarial verifier — runs the gate ladder (build, typecheck, lint, tests) against a finished change and tries to falsify it. Read-only; every finding carries path:line and a reproduction.

catalog.name: web-artifacts-builder

bug must be reproduced/verified in a browser

notInstalled.doc-coauthoring: Not installed. Substitute: write docs inline in existing docs/ style; use theme-factory only for styled artifacts.
notInstalled.skill-creator: Not installed. Create new skills by hand following the existing SKILL.md format.

servers.name: codegraph
servers.use: First stop for code questions in this repo; loads only when the session runs in the repo directory; read-only exploration.
servers.observed: MCP tool codegraph_explore + shell 'codegraph explore'; .codegraph/ index present; binary on PATH (codegraph.cmd)

servers.name: everything
servers.use: Smoke-test only, skip unless a demo:// URI is explicitly referenced. Never surface get-env output in logs or reports.
servers.observed: 7 static docs + 2 dynamic templates, all demo://resource/...; sample doc read OK

rules: codegraph is available only to sessions whose directory is the repo root; fall back to grep/read otherwise.
everything is demo-only: use only for explicit demo:// URI smoke tests; never dump get-env output.

agentPermissions.plan: OpenCode plan semantics: no edits to normal project files

rules: Only primary agents may start sessions: build (default), plan (planning-first). Project config pins default_agent to build.
Subagents (explore, general) are reachable only via the subagent tool from a primary session.
Complexity gate: >3 files OR migration/schema change OR auth/billing/permission/security surface => plan first (workflow-feature starts with plan).
Route to one workflow command: triage, explore, feature, bugfix, parallel, review.
Load skills only when their trigger matches (see skills.perWorkflow); never as defaults.
MCP: codegraph first for repo code questions; everything is demo-only, skip unless a demo:// URI is explicitly referenced.
Parallel work: contracts-first, max 4 general subagents, disjoint file ownership, never parallel migrations on the same table.
No workflow completes without its verification gates (see workflows.*.verify).
Workflow maintenance is additive and never edits app code or user work.

triage.purpose: Classify a request and route it; emits Workflow | Agents | Skills | MCP | First step.
verify: No edits made; routing table is complete and names only registered agents/skills/servers.

explore.purpose: Read-only understanding: files, symbols, data flow, tests, risks.
verify: No writes occurred; findings reference real paths and symbols.

feature.purpose: Plan and implement a new capability end-to-end.
verify: php artisan test --filter SeederIntegrityTest (if permissions/seeders changed)

bugfix.purpose: Reproduce, fix, and lock in a regression test.
verify: Failing test existed before the fix and passes after

parallel.purpose: Independent slices executed by up to 4 general subagents, contracts-first.
guardrails: never parallel migrations on the same table
verify: Integration in build; single full verification pass after merge.

review.purpose: Audit a diff/deliverable against repo guardrails; findings by severity.
verify: Relevant test suite for the reviewed code
Each finding has file:line and a concrete fix
